page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-8-lssd is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance featuring 8 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 64 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. Local storage is bundled via a single NVMe SSD offering 402 GB of capacity.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core CPU performance, with stress-ng single-core tests placing in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and database operations fall within the average range. However, a notable hardware tradeoff is present in memory bandwidth; while cached small-block reads are average, uncached large-block reads and writes are weak and poor, placing in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively.

Given its high memory density and local NVMe SSD storage, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that require fast local scratch space but are not heavily bottlenecked by uncached memory write speeds. It is suited for database operations, caching layers, text processing, and moderate web serving.
